I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread. I confirmed that the deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is 24 September, not the date in her #north-team post from this morning. She said no action was needed, so I didn't change anything else.

A deadline is an operational date, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in that channel.

One thing I didn't raise with her: today is 14 October, so 24 September has already passed. If she meant a future date, she may have the wrong one again.
